command: node benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/record-new-task-quit.mjs --tree <exact export of b6f10295a with node_modules>

comparison.method: each case whole: every recorded step, the core side built as `translated` states

normalised.fresh session address: numbered `<fresh:N>` by first appearance in the case on both sides
normalised.key order: objects without regard to key order; arrays in order

notRecorded.recorded[].reply.snapshot: the session snapshot Node's answer carries (session-host-lifecycle.ts:922,951); its workflow and orchestration mode are recorded as `settings`. The core's answer carries no snapshot (its session state travels on the subscription's feed)

desktopService.module: daemon.cjs built from the export by apps/desktop/scripts/build-daemon.mjs (its scripts/ and package-lock.json taken from the commit with git archive); the daemon loads it as the app names it (index.ts:467-485, desktop-service-registry.mjs:111-205)

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

random.fresh session address: a session address after a refusal reset is `sess_desktop_` + 32 random bytes in hex (freshSessionId, new-task-requests.ts:85); numbered `<fresh:N>` by first appearance in a case
